-- 0203 — DROP the attendance module.
--
-- Removes every table and column that existed only to serve attendance:
-- punches, biometric/device anti-proxy, leave & comp-off, the imported HR
-- attendance-sheet mirror, the month freeze, discipline notes, the Monday
-- week acknowledgement, and the per-employee / org-wide schedule + geofence
-- settings.
--
-- DESTRUCTIVE AND IRREVERSIBLE: all historic punch, leave and attendance-sheet
-- rows are deleted. Take a backup before applying.
--
-- Written defensively (IF EXISTS) so it is safe to re-run.

BEGIN;

-- ── Tables ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS attendance_week_ack         CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS attendance_sheet_day        CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS attendance_sheet_month      CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS attendance_discipline_notes CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS attendance_month_freeze     CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS paid_leave_cycle            CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS comp_off_credits            CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS leave_requests              CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS punch_nonces                CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS attendance_logs             CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mobile_devices              CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS webauthn_credentials        CASCADE;

-- ── employees: per-person schedule + anti-proxy columns ───────────────────
ALTER TABLE employees
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS attendance_biometric_exempt,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS weekly_off,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS att_official_start,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS att_late_after,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS att_official_end,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS att_early_before,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS att_full_day_minutes,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS att_half_day_minutes,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS weekly_target_minutes;

-- ── org_settings: geofence, office-IP gate, org schedule defaults ─────────
ALTER TABLE org_settings
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS office_lat,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS office_lng,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS attendance_radius_m,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS office_ip_allowlist,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS att_late_after,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS att_early_before,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS att_full_day_hours,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS att_half_day_hours;

-- ── Row data that referenced attendance ───────────────────────────────────
-- Notification kinds retired with the module (text column, no enum to alter).
DELETE FROM notifications
 WHERE kind IN (
   'attendance_late',
   'attendance_late_waived',
   'attendance_half_day',
   'attendance_device',
   'attendance_late_deduction'
 );

-- Single-use approval tokens for the Monday attendance confirmation.
DELETE FROM approval_tokens WHERE kind = 'attendance_confirm';

-- Sync-run audit rows for the retired attendance importers.
DELETE FROM sync_runs
 WHERE job IN ('attendance_backfill', 'attendance_sheet', 'paid_leave');

COMMIT;
